nodes.description: Private owner address; used for privileged access control and whitelist bypass in ensure().
Public mapping of token balances mutated by transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances decremented in transferFrom and set in approve/constructor.
Private mapping counting sales per address, incremented in transferFrom and read by condition().
Private mapping used as whitelist in ensure() to bypass sale conditions.
Private minimum sale amount set by init() and enforced by condition().
Private maximum sale amount set by init() and enforced by condition().
Private max number of sales per address set by init() and read by condition().
Address registered via setTradeAddress() and used in ensure() whitelist bypass.
Constant Uniswap router address checked in ensure() whitelist logic.
Public total supply written in the constructor.
Constant public decimals (18) used for scaling in init() and constructor.
Public token name set in constructor.
Public token symbol set in constructor.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balance and router allowance.
Payable transfer forwarding to transferFrom with msg.sender as source.
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale, otherwise requires condition().
Payable transferFrom that checks allowance, calls ensure(), and mutates balances and sale counters.
Payable approve that writes allowance for msg.sender.
Internal view sale-condition checker reading _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Owner-only init setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum scaled by decimals.
Owner-only batch distribution performing unchecked arithmetic and balance credits.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure computation of the Uniswap pair address via keccak256.
msg.sender controls authorization checks and is used as the transfer/approve source.
Low-level delegatecall executed on an arbitrary address with attacker/owner-supplied calldata.
Unchecked uint arithmetic in batchSend (_value * _tos.length and repeated balanceOf credits) that can overflow.
Parameter _value of transferFrom used for allowance/balance arithmetic.
Parameter _from of transferFrom used in allowance and ensure checks.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, credited balanceOf destination.
Parameter a of delegate, the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b of delegate, the calldata forwarded to delegatecall.
Parameter saleNum of init written to _saleNum.
Parameter token of init used to scale _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init used to scale _maxSale.
Parameter _tos of batchSend, recipient array iterated in the loop.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress written to tradeAddress.
Parameter recipient of transfer forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter amount of transfer forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter spender of approve used as allowance key.
Parameter amount of approve written to allowance.
Local _UNI in ensure, result of pairFor used for whitelist comparison.
Local total in batchSend computed as _value * _tos.length without overflow check.
Loop counter i in batchSend.

ensure whitelist bypass via canSale mapping
ensure whitelist bypass via tradeAddress
ensure compares _from against the constant UNI router

condition reads _saleNum
condition reads _minSale
condition reads _maxSale
condition reads _onSaleNum for the source address

init writes _maxSale
init writes _saleNum

batchSend performs unchecked multiplication and accumulation

constructor assigns owner
constructor assigns the deployer balanceOf
constructor assigns totalSupply

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _value only exists to drive the allowance and balance arithmetic of transferFrom.
Parameter _from is only used for the allowance and ensure checks inside transferFrom.
Parameter _to is only used to credit balanceOf inside transferFrom.
Parameter a is only used as the target of delegate's delegatecall.
Parameter b is the calldata directly executed by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Parameter saleNum is only written to _saleNum by init.
Parameter token is only used to scale _minSale in init.
Parameter maxToken is only used to scale _maxSale in init.
Parameter _tos is only iterated and measured by batchSend.
Parameter addr is only assigned to tradeAddress in setTradeAddress.
Parameter recipient is only forwarded by transfer to transferFrom.
Parameter amount is only forwarded by transfer to transferFrom.
Parameter spender is only used as the allowance key in approve.
Parameter amount is only written to allowance in approve.
Local _UNI holds the pairFor result used solely inside the ensure whitelist check.
Local total is the unchecked batch amount computed only inside batchSend.
Local i is the loop counter that exists only inside batchSend.
